name: f03-rental-hold-by-time-to-return
what: A rental deposit in 'hold' mode is held on the card only if the return day starts within HOLD_DAYS (6) of now. It used to be allowed by rental length alone, so a short rental booked weeks ahead got a hold that lapses before capture. Otherwise the deposit is charged and refunded on return, the existing fallback. New KindCheckout::holdFits() and HOLD_DAYS; header comment updated (finding cites :8).
decisions: Measured as the reviewers suggested: strtotime($to) - now <= 6*86400, where $to is the return day from dates() (a same-day rental's $to is the next day, which is more cautious).
Kept the old '$n > 6' test as well. It is implied by the new test, since 'from' is never in the past.

NEEDS A PERSON: is 6 days to the start of the return day enough slack? Stripe's online card authorization lasts about 7 days. If the business captures a day late, the hold can still lapse. A safer setting is HOLD_DAYS = 5. Default left at the reviewed 6.
risks: Nothing here has been run, tested or verified. It is a draft.

The hold is decided in prepare(). If payment happens much later (a pending/awaiting order paid near hold_until), the authorization is placed later, which only shortens the time to return. That case is safe. Payment-time code (MarketCheckout / the Stripe call) is not shown and not rechecked.
Buyers who booked ahead and expected a hold now see 'refunded on return' and are charged the deposit up front.

This is a whole-file release cut from the attached live KindCheckout.php alone. It does not contain f04/f18/f19/f20. Shipping several as-is, the later one overwrites the earlier, so the lane must merge. f19 also edits prepare(), but in the ticket/booking lines, not this one.
verify: Run tests/f03-rental-hold-window.php from tools/kind-tests/ (it requires ../../app/lib/KindCheckout.php and ItemKinds.php).

Stripe test mode only (QuickBooksPay::guardReal()/testHere() untouched; no real card). Run a 2-day rental starting in 3 weeks and expect 'Deposit (refunded on return)' with hold false. Run one returning in 3 days and expect 'held on your card'.
MarketCheckout (where $out['hold'] becomes the capture_method): file not shown. Confirm it reads only $out['hold'].
Gate number 5 is my guess for a money-touching change; confirm.
